S.FORM: ka sitsuayan azua i Tumapalapalai kata i Kavulungan selapay tu vavaw.
S.PHON: ka siʦuajan azua i tumapaɭapaɭai kata i kavuɭuŋan səɭapaj tu vavaw
S.FORM: ka sicuayan azua i Tumapalapalai kata i Kavulungan selapay tu vavaw.
S.PHON: ka siʦuajan azua i tumapaɭapaɭai kata i kavuɭuŋan səɭapaj tu vavaw
S.TRANSL: Once upon a time Tumapalapalai mountain and Kavulungan mountain were both extremely high (T. is the mountain behind Kapayuanan village (OA)).

S.FORM: "ari satekui," aya i Kavulungan tua i Tumapalapalai.
S.PHON: ari satəkui aja i kavuɭuŋan tua i tumapaɭapaɭai
S.FORM: "ari satekui," aya i Kavulungan tua i Tumapalapalai.
S.PHON: ari satəkui aja i kavuɭuŋan tua i tumapaɭapaɭai
S.TRANSL: "Let's go down," said Kavulungan to Tumapalapalai.

S.FORM: "ui, ari ari, katjaisangasu a sema teku," aya i Tumapalapalai tua i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: ui ari ari kacaisaŋasu a səma təku aja i tumapaɭapaɭai tua i kavuɭuŋan
S.FORM: "ui, ari ari, katjaisangasu a sema teku," aya i Tumapalapalai tua i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: ui ari ari kacaisaŋasu a səma təku aja i tumapaɭapaɭai tua i kavuɭuŋan
S.TRANSL: "Yes, all right; you go down first," said Tumapalapalai to Kavulungan.

S.FORM: "ini, tisunay a tjaisangas a sema teku," aya i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: ini tisunaj a caisaŋas a səma təku aja i kavuɭuŋan
S.FORM: "ini, tisunay a tjaisangas a sema teku," aya i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: ini tisunaj a caisaŋas a səma təku aja i kavuɭuŋan
S.TRANSL: "No, you go down first," said Kavulungan.

S.FORM: kilangda tua kai na i Kavulungan; sema teku a i Tumapalapalai.
S.PHON: kiɭaŋda tua kai na i kavuɭuŋan səma təku a i tumapaɭapaɭai
S.FORM: kilangda tua kai na i Kavulungan; sema teku a i Tumapalapalai.
S.PHON: kiɭaŋda tua kai na i kavuɭuŋan səma təku a i tumapaɭapaɭai
S.TRANSL: Tumapalapalai did as Kavulungan said and went down.

S.FORM: qau sema vavaw a i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: qau səma vavaw a i kavuɭuŋan
S.FORM: qau sema vavaw a i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: qau səma vavaw a i kavuɭuŋan

S.FORM: avan anga sika vavaw na i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: avan aŋa sika vavaw na i kavuɭuŋan
S.FORM: avan anga sika vavaw na i Kavulungan.
S.PHON: avan aŋa sika vavaw na i kavuɭuŋan
S.TRANSL: So that is why Kavulungan is so high.
